label: vfile_open_wrapper

label: bitmap_file_loader

label: texture_bitmap_loader
note: Handles texture and optional alpha bitmaps, caching/world registration, and VFile closes

label: bsp_world_loader
note: Opens a BSP VFile, passes its handle to geWorld_Create as confirmed by x86, then registers the world

label: world_collision_wrapper
note: General extent-plus-segment collision wrapper selects one of two world handles and returns hit position/normal

label: actor_pose_adapter
note: Sets or clears actor pose; selected motion time can be derived from a global timer

label: actor_pose_adapter
note: Sets or clears an actor pose with a transform when the object state permits

label: actor_scale_pose
note: Updates actor scale and then its selected motion pose with a transform

label: frame_bitmap_display
note: Begins a frame, draws a bitmap, ends the frame, then calls additional display-state helpers

label: firerescue_floor_collision
note: FireRescue FloorMe path probes the world floor and logs rescue\FireRescueEnt.cpp line 0x231 on failure

label: world_collision_multistep
note: Performs repeated world-collision queries in a multi-step movement/interaction routine; enclosing role remains provisional

label: world_segment_collision
note: Uses a zero-extent segment query with flags 0x43 and a conditional bit-2 mode

label: world_vertical_probe
note: Builds a vertical probe interval and returns an adjusted hit height

label: world_extent_probe
note: Builds symmetric extents from a radius-like input and returns collision position and normal

label: world_render_callsite
note: Selects active world and camera and calls geEngine_RenderWorld

label: empty_world_create
note: Creates an empty geWorld, stores it, and registers it with geEngine

label: frame_dispatcher
note: Drains pre-frame callbacks, prepares draw objects, brackets virtual draw callbacks with BeginFrame/EndFrame

label: preframe_callbacks
note: Calls queued pre-frame objects at vtable +0x08 when a world handle is present, then clears the pending list

label: game_input_camera_update
note: Guarded alternate game-update path reads mouse state, dispatches a frame, updates player actor/camera state, and calls the cursor input sink

label: level_manifest_parser
note: Parses the level catalog keys and builds level records; Training entry cross-checked against copied thegame.lev

label: world_entity_load
note: WorldEntity vtable method loads its +0x24 BSP path and queues entities; selected-level request matches the path and service, with virtual dispatch still open.

label: level_selection_dispatch
note: Indexes the level-choice collection and passes the selected record to 0042AB00 for event values 0 or 1; dispatch is indirect through data at 004DFD18.

label: level_key_suffix_helper
note: Appends a supplied suffix to the string in the level record's first field; 0042AB00 supplies .bsp.

label: active_level_start
note: Stores the active level record, derives its BSP/EVS path, then initializes world route and spawn state.

label: delayed_script_owner_constructor
note: Stores a script path and initializes a four-callback countdown used by 0049E2C0; callback cadence and owner relation to selected level remain open.

label: delayed_evs_load_callback
note: Decrements a counter and calls 00471310 in mode 0 when it reaches zero; invocation timing remains unknown.

label: evs_path_mode_dispatch
note: Normalizes the input path to .evs and dispatches mode 0 to 0047A070 or nonzero mode to 0047A130.

label: evs_mode0_wrapper
note: Calls the common 004799E0 parser in mode 0.

label: evs_mode1_wrapper
note: Calls the common 004799E0 parser in mode 1 and is the target of the execsetsonly statement; exact filtering semantics remain open.

label: script_source_parser
note: Parses script/map source and has Data\\Scripts and Data\\Maps path branches; fallback conditions and event-binding effects remain open.

label: script_statement_dispatch
note: Routes exec to 0047A070 and execsetsonly to 0047A130; recognized statement handlers do not alone prove runtime reachability.

label: level_collection_constructor
note: Initializes the level-choice collection embedded at subsystem offset +0x6AC.

label: level_record_lookup
note: Scans level entries and returns the record whose +0x18 ordinal matches the requested value.

label: array_slot_append
note: Stores an element pointer in the first empty slot of a dynamic pointer array.

label: script_binding_bridge
note: Stores supplied context at ScriptActor +0x78 and forwards command text to 00470150 in mode 0.

label: script_actor_command_dispatch
note: Substitutes *ME dispatches common commands invokes vtable +4 fallback and logs unknown commands.

label: bounds_trigger_script_registration
note: Passes non-null BoundsTrigger script fields to ScriptActor and checks touch for tell player escape.

label: script_event_command_contains
note: Checks an event command list for a specified command and returns a boolean result.

label: player_script_command_handler
note: Handles Player script commands including escape and calls the Player escape prepass.

label: player_escape_prepass
note: Applies a guarded Player state snapshot then calls rescue completion.

label: player_rescue_complete
note: Completes a carried-victim rescue updates statistics clears carry state and refreshes exit zones.

label: script_base_command_router
note: Handles ScriptActor control and message commands before derived command fallback.

label: script_token_compare
note: Byte-wise string comparison used to filter mode-1 EVS statements to the set and exec tokens.

label: named_registry_lookup
note: Looks up a name object in a bucketed registry and returns its stored value; the Training loader uses it with World.

label: spawn_request_path_setter
note: Stores the selected BSP path in the first field of a spawn request.

label: selected_level_map_path
note: Builds data\maps\<level-key>.bsp from the selected level record.

label: map_key_path_join
note: Appends the selected level record key to the data\maps\ prefix.

label: spawn_queue_drain
note: Drains factory requests by calling the stored factory at virtual slot +8 then registers objects and runs two initialization passes.

label: world_entity_factory
note: Allocates and constructs WorldEntity through 0049E240; its descriptor vtable entry is verified in the pinned EXE.

label: victim_resource_init
note: Hash-matched Ghidra constructor export: unknown D_Type logs and uses the configured default; unresolved model suppresses victim creation; model 14 branches to 11-13.

label: victim_type_default_fallback
note: Unknown resource names resolve to the first loaded victim record; an empty catalog yields an empty name.

label: victim_resource_catalog_loader
note: Reads Victim declarations sequentially and appends records in declaration order.

label: victim_resource_lookup
note: Performs a zero-based linear name lookup over the loaded victim resource array.

label: resizable_array_growth
note: Resizes the array with realloc and zeroes new slots, preserving prior catalog entries.

label: random_modulo_helper
note: Returns pseudorandom modulo the requested bound; model 14 uses the result modulo 3.

label: renderer_model_resource_query
note: Routes the selected renderer model ID to the loaded renderer-model table lookup.

label: renderer_actor_create_dispatch
note: Passes the selected renderer model ID into renderer actor creation.

label: renderer_actor_construct_from_model
note: Looks up the selected model ID and constructs/stores a renderer actor.

label: renderer_model_table_lookup
note: Searches the loaded renderer-model table by model ID and returns its payload.

label: victim_type_config_lookup
note: Looks up the original victim resource by type name and creates its per-victim configuration.

label: victim_type_config_construct
note: Builds per-victim audio/behavior state from the configured resource collections.

label: victim_material_variant_selection
note: Selects per-model material cursor and copies selected material to actor slot zero.

label: material_variant_cursor_lookup
note: Looks up the next material index by model ID in the shared cache tree.

label: material_variant_cursor_resolve
note: Returns the existing model-keyed cursor or creates a new cache node.

label: HandleFireRescueMotionCommand
note: Recognizes moveto, stopmove, and setsize; maps MBase moveto operand parsing to the FireRescue path-move helper.

label: SetFireRescuePathPointMove
note: Resolves a named PathPoint, guards recursive targeting, stores displacement/rate state, and enters FireRescue motion state 4.

label: FindPathPointByName
note: Performs case-insensitive lookup in the PathPoint registry and returns the matching entry.

label: SetFireRescueSizeMotion
note: Resets the FireRescue timed-vector state, adds the current size at game time +10, and inserts the requested size at game time + float_duration*1000. The size transition is interpolated; seconds-to-clock-unit interpretation is inferred from the 1000.0f scale. Ghidra C-like output omits the x87 duration use.

label: AddFireRescueMotionKey
note: Inserts a timed three-component key, preserving the current vector when a new key precedes the pending second key.

label: ConfigurePathPointEntity
note: Initializes PathPoint identity and dispatches its ten authored script fields.

label: InitializeAndRegisterScriptActor
note: Stores actor identity and two supplied words, then registers the actor with ScriptEngine.

label: ScriptEngineAddActor
note: Adds an actor pointer to ScriptEngine’s sparse actor registry.

label: ScriptEngineRemoveActor
note: Removes an actor pointer from ScriptEngine’s registry.

label: UpdateFireRescueActor
note: Maps state-4 route motion and confirms mode 5 returns before actor visual updates; alpha/effect lifecycle and external scheduling remain unresolved.

label: AdvanceFireRescuePathMotion
note: Advances FireRescue route state and builds child/timed keys; trailing command values at +0xB0/+0xB4 are independently scaled by 1000.0f, added to base key times, rounded, and stored. Old exports were reused; the C-like decompilation omits the x87 operand chain, so exact authoring terms and runtime schedule remain open.

label: UpdateFireRescueTimedVectorTrack
note: Consumes current and future timed-vector keys, advances the active key against global time, linearly interpolates the vector, scales it by the embedded transform factors, and writes the new position when it changes beyond the stored threshold. Called within the FireRescue update path through FUN_0044B060. Two earlier same-address exports were compared; the fresh C-like body matches after function renaming.

label: ProcessFireRescueSpread
note: Rechecked intensity-gated random child creation, half-minimum horizontal size radius, downward surface sweep, randomized child size keys and retry deadline against current hash-pinned decompilation and x87 listing. Candidate dispatch/cadence remains open.

label: UpdateFireRescueProximityAndSpread
note: Tracks crossings of the 750-unit max-axis distance gate, stores the latest distance at FireRescue +0x120, and calls random spread for each qualifying callback below 750. The external callback scheduler remains open.

label: DispatchFireRescueExposureUpdate
note: Recovered a missing function boundary from the FireRescue vtable +0x48 slot. Maps the 750/500 distance gates, influence/visibility record, and message 0x7531 into the Player receiver. Regular manager dispatch cadence remains open.

label: ComputeFireVolumeFalloff
note: Mapped the vertically compressed ellipsoid falloff formula and second caller at 0x00463EF0. Native return is x87 ST0; Ghidra MCP normalizes the signature to float because manual float10 thiscall typing inserted a false hidden return-storage parameter. Current assembly and pre-normalization export preserve extended-return evidence.

label: DispatchPlayerMessage
note: Recovered Player vtable message handler at 0x004E1C50. Message 0x7531 carries FireRescue pointer plus influence and routes to ApplyPlayerFireExposure; 30000 and 0x7532 use separate handlers.

label: ApplyPlayerFireExposure
note: Maps facing, RC_Pain deadline and Serious Burns stat, 1.2*frameDelta*influence burn accumulation, and the strict extended-precision passout threshold. The Ghidra C-like body omits clock addition; saved assembly carries exact ordering.

label: ApplyFireSuppressionContact
note: Full five-word stack ABI now exposed. Contact xyz are not read; intensity uses global frame delta, definition spray duration and nonlinear influence curve. Only finalize=1 can set mode 5 below the strict 0.1 threshold.

label: DispatchFireRescueSprayMessage
note: Recovered missing boundary from FireRescue vtable +0x08. Message 0x7530 carries xyz and influence and reaches shared suppression with finalize=0.

label: ApplyHoseFireContact
note: HoseSpray update calls this helper while spray action +0xC58 is active. It iterates FireRescue candidates, evaluates ellipsoid influence and calls shared suppression with finalize=1.

label: UpdateHoseSpray
note: Recovered missing boundary from primary vtable slot +0x24. Maps item mode/action gate and direct call to hose FireRescue contact handling; engine scheduling order remains open.

label: AppendAndSendSprayContact
note: Builds a bounded 16-byte xyz+influence record, dispatches message 0x7530, then increments the record count. Three callsites are listed; their individual source owners remain under review.

label: ApplyFireRescueSpriteAlpha
note: Sets alpha on the three fire sprite children and glow child; glow alpha receives a separate multiplier.

label: DisableFireRescueSprites
note: Clears child-system +0xCC flags for four visual children when the callback strength branch invokes it.

label: UpdateFireRescueVisualEffects
note: Advances the visual timed-vector track and handles bounds, smoke, and culling work called by the FireRescue actor update.
